hypothesis: Applying the BTC/ETH-hardened protocol to SOL for the first time -- the corrected causal triple-barrier trade-outcome label (12-bar cumret vol basis, TP2.5/SL1.2, 288-bar horizon), fresh-forward bar-by-bar evaluation, and N=5 genuinely random seeds -- determines whether SOL's 5m panel contains extractable entry edge for (a) a LightGBM control, (b) deep models (TabM-style flat MLP ensemble and a causal windowed CNN/Transformer encoder), and (c) a continuous-control DSAC RL agent, with DL and RL deliberately emphasized per user direction despite their BTC failures, because SOL has never been tested with this label or these architectures.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: All four related lines failed on BTC, and SOL's own architecture-v2 (TCN+CatBoost, 20260719) was rejected before the 20260806 label fix existed. Why those verdicts may not transfer: (1) every BTC DL/RL failure was measured on BTC, whose market-efficiency ceiling (project-btc-ceiling memo 20260720) is believed to be the binding constraint -- SOL is a structurally less efficient market where the same architectures have never been run; (2) SOL's only prior architecture cycle used the retrospective zigzag/wave-style labels and single-bar-noise SL sizing that the 2026-08-06 diagnosis identified as root causes of the acc-vs-PnL gap; the corrected trade-outcome label has never been built for SOL; (3) the BTC advanced-RL verdict (REDQ/TQC/CQL/DSAC-T 3 seeds OOS-negative) predates the corrected label and was trained on BTC reward streams only.
research.retest_design: Identical pinned SOL panel and identical corrected TB trade-outcome label for every candidate. Stage 0: oracle label-following replay must show a real positive ceiling under the 10bps cost model on train+VAL before any model is trained (4-step oracle protocol). Stage 1 cheap gate: LightGBM 3-class on flat features; its VAL/OOS fresh-forward result is the control every DL/RL candidate must beat. Stage 2 DL: flat MLP-ensemble (TabM-style) and causal windowed CNN/Transformer, each N=5 genuinely random seeds, VAL-only selection, single OOS read per pre-registered candidate. Stage 3 RL: DSAC continuous agent on the same panel and cost model, 5 random seeds, evaluated only by fresh-forward replay of its greedy policy. No OOS-derived tuning anywhere; OOS is read once per pre-registered candidate.

model.candidate_architecture: flat MLP-ensemble (TabM-style) N=5 seeds; causal window48 CNN/Transformer N=5 seeds; DSAC continuous RL N=5 seeds -- all against the LightGBM control

selection.validation_pass_criteria: candidate must be VAL-positive after costs with >=15 trades AND beat the LightGBM control's VAL PnL on seed-mean; only then does it earn its single OOS read; OOS adoption additionally requires seed-mean OOS PnL > 0 with >=3/5 seeds positive
